title: azure-marketplace-ambassador-sync-prep-kai-draft
content:
Meeting: Azure Marketplace Ambassador / Channel Sync (prep notes)
Owner: Kai Reynolds (me)
When: 2026-03-15 09:00 PT (30m)
Participants (expected): Azure Partnerships - Lena Park (AM), Diego M., Channel Sales - Priya, Internal: Luis (legal), Hannah (product), myself.

Objective (top-line):
- Align on ambassador program timeline for Azure listing (co-marketing windows, SKU/usage visibility, billing flow tests).
- Get commitments on technical review dates and PR approvals so we can hit the marketplace listing by 2026-04-15.
- Surface any blocking commercial terms (SLA/cancellation/revenue share) that need legal review.

Desired meeting outcomes (3):
1) Concrete dates for tech review + test listing (target: 2026-03-22 for test).
2) Azure says they can provide co-marketing assets by 2026-03-29.
3) Agreement on telemetry visibility scope (billing events + aggregated usage) and who will own implementation.

Agenda (mine) - 30m
- 0:00-0:03 quick intros (Lena, Diego)
- 0:03-0:08 high-level ask + timeline (me)
- 0:08-0:14 technical readiness (Hannah + Luis input)
- 0:14-0:20 commercial terms + co-marketing (Priya)
- 0:20-0:27 blockers/prereqs + action owner assignment
- 0:27-0:30 quick recap & next steps

Prep notes / talking points (quick bullets to say):
- "We want to target a public listing by April 15; test listing 3/22 to validate metering + billing across L3 SKUs."
- Emphasize Redwood selling points for Azure audience: predictable inference economics, dedicated capacity option (important for enterprise regulated customers), private deployment capabilities for VNet/HSM.
- Ask for an Azure contact for Marketplace telemetry testing (who can provision the test tenant to exercise metering?).
- Confirm whether Azure requires marketplace-specific pricing table or we can use existing Redwood pricing with mapping sheet.

Technical readiness checklist to surface (Hannah to confirm live):
- Metering endpoints implemented: yes/no? (internal ticket: JIRA:MP-487)
- Billing event sampling and webhooks validated in a test tenant
- Deployment artifact: marketplace listing package built in repo (GH PR #98) - still needs final docstring and readme for Azure schema
- E2E test plan: create VM -> call Redwood API via marketplace token -> verify usage and metering logs -> invoice event generated

Risks / open questions (to bring up explicitly):
- Legal: revenue share / refund window — Luis to bring the standard Redwood marketplace clause; ask Azure if they need a different clause.
- Telemetry granularity: Azure may want line-item per-customer token counts; we should propose aggregated daily metrics to start to avoid PII exposure.
- Support model: who handles first-line support for marketplace-billed customers? We propose Redwood support with Azure triage. Need Azure confirmation.

Personal notes (how I will run the convo):
- Keep timeline anchored "April 15"; ask for "if not, what is realistic?"
- If legal pushes long lead time, ask for an interim "private listing / co-sell" approach that doesn't block customer trials.
- If telemetry is a blocker, offer Redwood engineers to pair with Azure test engineer on 3/22 test run.

Numbers to bring (quick snippets) - have these on a single slide/one-pager:
- Current hosted revenue MRR baseline: $210k (last quarter) - call out expected uplift from marketplace listing: conservative 8-12% in Q2
- Average per-customer monthly token usage: 1.1M tokens (for top 10 customers)
- Latency SLA targets for dedicated instances: p99 < 200ms token generation (redwood-dedicated claim)

Asks / action items to close in meeting (write down owner + soft due date):
- Azure to nominate test tenant + telemetry contact (owner: Lena) - due: 2026-03-18
- Redwood to finalize marketplace listing package (GH PR #98) and submit for tech review (owner: Hannah + Kai) - due: 2026-03-20
- Legal to prepare marketplace clause options (owner: Luis) - due: 2026-03-19
- Marketing assets for co-marketing (owner: Priya) - Azure to confirm availability by 2026-03-29

Post-meeting follow-up template (quick copy):
"Thanks — great sync. Confirmed actions: 1) Azure will provide test tenant contact (Lena) by 3/18; 2) Redwood to submit test listing 3/20; 3) Legal will circulate clause options by 3/19. Next sync proposed: 3/23 10am PT for test results.
Please reply if any dates need adjusting."

Notes-to-self (after meeting, expected quick writes):
- If Azure asks for deeper telemetry, escalate to SRE/observability (link: confluence:mp-telemetry-reqs)
- Keep the internal rollout plan flexible: if marketplace listing is delayed, prioritize co-sell enablement with Partner Sales playbook (Priya).

Quick checklist before the meeting (tick off):
- [ ] Slide with numbers (MRR, avg tokens, p99) - DONE (Kai)
- [ ] GH PR #98 draft and README - IN PROGRESS (Hannah)
- [ ] JIRA:MP-487 metering ticket updated with test plan - TODO (Hannah)
summary: Draft scratchpad for Azure marketplace ambassador sync. Focus on timelines (test listing 3/22, public 4/15), telemetry and legal asks, owners for each action, and quick follow-up template.
